title: Drunk Florida Woman Goes Berserk, Fights Cops at Concert!
description:
On October 19th, 2023, officers in Florida were called to a concert following an incident involving an intoxicated attendee who had reportedly pushed a security officer. Upon arrival, the venue's security team informed officers that the female suspect had refused to leave the property despite being asked to do so multiple times. Officers located the suspect on a stairwell leading towards the stage and informed her that she needed to leave. However, the suspect continued to resist and ignored the officers' instructions.

The suspect became increasingly uncooperative as officers attempted to escort her out of the venue. Near the concessions area, the suspect turned and pushed an officer in the chest. Despite attempts to de-escalate the situation, the suspect's aggression persisted. When they reached the exit, the suspect turned again and punched an officer in the chest, leading to her arrest; as she resisted, officers had to restrain her and place her in handcuffs.

The suspect was eventually subdued and taken to the County Jail. During the transport, she continued to be disruptive with officers. The suspect was charged with Resisting an Officer without Violence and Trespass In An Occupied Structure Or Conveyance.
